description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of five different models across three evaluation metrics. The horizontal axis contains the categories, representing the models evaluated: "Single-task_baseline", "Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout", "Unsupervised_SimCSE", "Supervised_SimCSE", and "2-Tier SimCSE", which are ordered from left to right without a specific alphabetical or value-based sorting, and the axis itself does not have a title. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Accuracy / Correlation", featuring a linear scale that ranges from 0 to slightly above 0.8, with major tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.2 and minor ticks every 0.04. The chart features grouped vertical bars, where each category on the horizontal axis contains a cluster of three adjacent bars. According to the legend at the top, the light yellow bars represent "Sentiment Acc.", the light pink bars represent "STS Corr.", and the light blue bars represent "Paraphrase Acc.". Across the categories, the light yellow "Sentiment Acc." bars range from approximately 0.49 for both Supervised_SimCSE and 2-Tier SimCSE—the shortest bars in the chart—to roughly 0.53 for Single-task_baseline. The light pink "STS Corr." bars show a general increase from left to right, starting at approximately 0.50 for Single-task_baseline and reaching the tallest value in the chart at approximately 0.81 for 2-Tier SimCSE. The light blue "Paraphrase Acc." bars remain relatively consistent across all groups, ranging narrowly between approximately 0.77 for Unsupervised_SimCSE and 0.79 for Single-task_baseline. There are no visually emphasized bars, and the chart is set against a faint dotted grid background.
